description:
Keep everything you need within arm's reach with the 2-Drawer Nightstand from Fisher Quality Products. Compact enough to fit beside a glider or crib, this solid hardwood nightstand offers just the right amount of storage for late-night essentials.
Two smooth-gliding drawers with dovetail construction provide space for pacifiers, burp cloths, lotions, books, and a glass of water. The sturdy top is perfect for a lamp, monitor, or small decor piece. Crafted from solid hardwoods with a warm Brown Maple finish, this nightstand brings lasting durability and timeless style to your nursery.
The clean lines and classic silhouette coordinate beautifully with the full FQP furniture collection, making it easy to create a pulled-together nursery look. After the baby years, it transitions effortlessly to a bedroom, guest room, or living space. Non-toxic, baby-safe finishes throughout. Assembly is straightforward with all hardware included.
